lines: d37: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Malik Makarov is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d37: 🕯️ Malik Makarov is dead — a stranger. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d37: What Malik kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d37: "Malik's gone." Fritz looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Malik." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d37: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Harper blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d37: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d37: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d37: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d37: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d37: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d37: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d37: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Malik Makarov, 37 days. The mantle passes to Harper Vogt.
d37: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Harper Vogt, 33 — an interpreter. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Scream Cheese, Green Thumb, Literally.
d37: The village's quarrel was with Malik — and Malik is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d37: At the grave, Fritz, James, Umberto and 2 more speak for Harper — "Malik trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d37: The fire knew Harper before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
